SYMPTOM: sizeId=599 for waist 30 returned 0 results for pants, then showed children's shoes (size 30)

CAUSE: Vinted's W30/W32 pants sizes appear in listing titles but are NOT filterable via size_ids API param. IDs around 595-607 are shoe sizes. Pants use letter sizes (S/M/L/XL) only.

FIX: Map numeric waist values to letter equivalents: 26-28→S (206), 29-31→M (208), 32-34→L (209), 35-37→XL (210), 38+→XXL (211)

IMPLEMENTED: lib/vinted-sizes.ts — WAIST_TO_LETTER map + resolveSize() that handles tops, bottoms (letter), shoes (separate ID range), and returns undefined for accessories

ACCESSORIES: Bags, watches, sunglasses, belts, scarves — resolveSize() returns undefined, no size_ids filter applied

SHOE SIZE IDs: 44→788 (confirmed working), 41→783, etc. These ARE numeric and work correctly.
